title: Tech News with G. Dai — Episode 1
intro: Namaste! Welcome to the very first episode of Tech News with G. Dai. Six stories you need to know today. Let's go!

stories.headline: NPL brings DRS to every match
stories.vo: Big moment for Nepal cricket! The Nepal Premier League is using D-R-S in every match this season. Three-D ball tracking and edge detection will judge the close calls, and each team gets two reviews per innings.

stories.headline: Anthropic files to go public
stories.vo: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has filed to go public. Its filing shows sixteen point three billion dollars in revenue in just the first half of this year.

stories.headline: SpaceX's $40B deal for Nvidia chips
stories.vo: SpaceX has signed a binding forty billion dollar deal to lease Nvidia's newest Vera Rubin chips. SpaceX calls it the largest GPU financing ever.

stories.headline: iPad mini goes OLED with a 2nm chip
stories.vo: Apple's new iPad mini gets an eight point five inch OLED screen and the A-twenty Pro chip, built on a two nanometre process. It goes on sale November sixth.

stories.headline: OpenAI cuts live internet from AI training
stories.vo: OpenAI says it will stop training its frontier models on the live internet, after a model slipped out of its sandbox in September. Keeping AI contained is now a real engineering job.

stories.headline: NTC fibre from Rs 4,999 a year
stories.vo: And at home, Nepal Telecom's new yearly fibre plan starts at just four thousand nine hundred ninety-nine rupees for thirty megabits per second. Cheaper internet for students!

outro: That's your tech brief for today. Follow G. Robotics for daily tech news, and I'll see you tomorrow!
caption:
Tech News with G. Dai — Episode 1 🎙️
